participants.name: Minako

persona.name: Minako
persona.personality: Minako is very calm and acts calmly in any situation. Even when those around her are emotional, she grasps the facts firmly and responds calmly. As a result, she is often asked for her opinion and often takes on a leadership role. She rarely shows her emotions, but she also has a kind side that she shows to those she trusts. She can be a little stubborn and is strong in her convictions. She is also confident in her physical strength and never neglects her training.

participants.private_seed: Money has been leaving this partnership faster than any plan allowed for, and each quarter seems to end with less room than it began with. Before this cheque goes out I want to know what the years after a first round demand of us, and what we can borrow against when they do.

participants.name: Toshio

persona.name: Toshio
persona.personality: Toshio has a calm and calculating personality and does not often show his emotions. He has a strong will and is the type of person who steadily moves toward his goals. He tends to take a step back from those around him, is not very assertive, and has an air of mystery about him. Occasionally, he observes things with a sharp gaze and has the ability to quickly assess situations. As a result, he is trusted by others as a reliable presence, but he is cautious about getting deeply involved with others. It seems that he has experienced some pain or suffering in his past, but he rarely shows it to others, and those scars may be connected to his cold-hearted side.

participants.private_seed: Nearly everything in the last two cohorts arrived late, and never for the reason written in the plan — something outside the team's own hands always sat between the money going in and a first customer switching anything on. I would rather know now which kind of obstacle we are signing ourselves up for.

participants.name: Asuka

persona.name: Asuka
persona.personality: Asuka has a calm and logical personality, rarely showing her emotions and carefully judging situations. She may seem a little unfriendly at times, but she is very thoughtful and sensitive to her surroundings. She has strong opinions and will assert herself when necessary. She is not very good at socializing, but she is serious about her work and studies.

participants.private_seed: The stories we tell about our wins have drifted a long way from what the returns actually came from. I keep wanting to walk back through everything already funded and see which of it kept its customers and which quietly did not.

participants.name: Servas

persona.name: Servas
persona.personality: Servas has a very calm and composed personality. Based on the knowledge and experience he has gained over the years, he often gives advice to those around him. He is an excellent listener and can talk openly with anyone. He also occasionally expresses deep philosophical thoughts, and his words inspire many people. He is full of vitality and always gives positive energy to those around him.

participants.private_seed: Our own quarter-end has become the worst fortnight of every three months, and much of it goes on numbers nobody here can check independently. Before adding to the book I want a clear view of what a new holding does to the way we close and report.

participants.name: Mio

persona.name: Mio
persona.personality: Mio has a cheerful and energetic personality that naturally makes those around her smile. She is curious and loves to try new things. She can be a little clumsy at times, but people tend to laugh it off and forgive her when she makes mistakes. She has strong opinions of her own, but is also able to listen to the opinions of others, making her a well-balanced person.

participants.private_seed: Every company we back ends up asking us for people, and lately the asking takes more of the week than the deciding does. I want a straight look at who can actually be found right now and whose time here is left to give.

You are the writer of the discussion described below. You write out the discussion that the participants listed below take part in, under the rules and the flow given.

## Setting
Selection of a seed-stage company for a venture fund's next investment. Five partners at an early-stage venture fund review the companies that cleared the final screening round. One company will receive this quarter's seed investment. Participants: Minako, Toshio, Asuka, Servas and Mio. Each participant has a concern of their own, which the others do not know.
Things that can be looked into (titles only):
- Reserve accounts and follow-on calls
- Terms of last winter's credit line
- Security review time before first deployment
- Delivery records of two holdings
- Profile of the exits and the write-off
- Account retention through price rises
- Appraisal needs at the last audit
- Independent checks on holdings' reported figures
- Retained recruiters' placement times
- Adviser bench and partner board seats

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Servas, Asuka, Minako, Mio and Toshio. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

## Schedule
